methodological_rigor.justification: Methodology section not fully accessible; appears case-based or observational. Limited detail on sample size, statistical methods, control comparisons. Case series or case report design evident from structure.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Case series/report level evidence (LoE 4). Clinical relevance present but limited by small numbers and descriptive nature. Demonstrates feasibility and safety rather than efficacy comparison.

reporting_quality.justification: Limited adherence to standardized reporting. No explicit data sharing statement. Methods incompletely described for external replication.

novelty_literature.justification: Incremental case reporting of existing technique. Limited novel contribution to literature.

writing_presentation.justification: Readable but brief sections; adequate case presentation. Could benefit from expanded methodology and results sections.

key_concerns: Case series/report design with limited evidence level
chief_reviewer.rationale: Case series with inadequate methodological detail. Requires substantial revision addressing study design transparency and statistical rigor for Tier 4 publication.
